messages:
elsa: Opening a small PR for the on-prem quickstart: focuses on minimal KMS proxy, HSM agent hints, and an air-gapped image fetch example. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1315 :wave:
mike: linking. Can you add an explicit check that customers run for image integrity (sha256) and a curl fallback that retries? We get a lot of flaky mirrors.
elsa: added the exact curl+verify snippet: `curl -fSLO --retry 5 https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-03/images.tar.gz && curl -fSLO --retry 5 https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-03/images.tar.gz.sha256 && sha256sum -c images.tar.gz.sha256` and an scp fallback for isolated sites.
tara: nice. For the KMS proxy, paste the tiny haproxy config we use in the docs so customers with older distros have an alternative to nginx.
elsa: done. minimal haproxy snippet we added:
```
frontend kms_front
  bind 127.0.0.1:8443
  mode tcp
  default_backend kms_back

backend kms_back
  mode tcp
  server kms1 kms.internal:8443 check
```
mike: in the HSM section, please replace "expose certs" with clearer language: "KMS must terminate TLS using a cert signed by the customer's root CA; private key material must remain on the HSM where supported." Also add an openssl check example for vendors.
elsa: swapped the sentence and added `openssl s_client -connect kms.internal:8443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` and a short PKCS#11 probe: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/*/pkcs11* -L || pkcs11-tool --module /usr/local/lib/*pkcs11* -L` so customers can run a quick enumeration.
tara: can you also add a tiny systemd unit for the kms-proxy and show socket activation? Some customers prefer that for low-footprint start.
elsa: added a one-liner plus socket unit. kept it short.
deploy-bot: CI: docs lint OK for PR 1315.
docs-bot: PR 1315: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @mike, @tara.
mike: quick link-fix: the migration checklist link was pointing at /vpc/setup instead of /vpc/migrate. small PR coming.
elsa: thanks, fixed the link and noted a follow-up todo to add a tiny shell script that scans common PKCS#11 paths and prints versions. Will land post-merge if no objections.
tara: LGTM. If CI stays green I'll approve in the next hour. :thumbsup:
elsa: great, merging after green CI and will backport a 2-line note into the migration checklist page. Thanks all!
